opening.argument: The presentation promotes a purchasable gold-linked coin with a claimed backing and ways to convert or use it. The speaker says, “This coin can be purchased, can be bought,” and claims that “for every crypto coin that I give on your account, we as a company have to store some gold.” Holders are told they can “sell your gold, get cash for it or buy more of this coin.” The offer also links joining OneCoin by a stated deadline to receiving free gold coins. While the speaker acknowledges that “Gold can also go down,” that caveat does not establish that the claimed gold backing, exchange, or cash-out process works; the supplied material does not independently verify them.

citations.quote: This coin can be purchased, can be bought
for every crypto coin that I give on your account, we as a company have to store some gold.
Every day you can go and sell your gold, get cash for it or buy more of this coin.
So whoever joins one coin until then... Will still receive the free gold coins... Until the first of September.
